veranderings.voor: in wat nou die Noordwes-provinsie is
veranderings.na: in die gebied wat nou die Noordwes-provinsie is
veranderings.rede: 'In wat nou ... is' copies English 'in what is now'; naming the area reads more naturally in Afrikaans and keeps the protected name intact.

veranderings.voor: daarmee met ander groepe handel gedryf
veranderings.rede: 'Daarmee handel gedryf' is stiff and loosely attached; 'dit verhandel' says plainly that the metals were traded.
Two 'in' phrases in a row read clumsily; 'gedurende' separates place from time.

veranderings.voor: Van die klipmure sien ons vandag die ruïnes.
veranderings.na: Vandag sien ons die ruïnes van die klipmure.
veranderings.rede: Fronting 'Van die klipmure' is awkward; the natural order puts the time first and keeps 'ruïnes van die klipmure' together.
The noun 'bewys' reads more naturally with the article here.
'Beskilder' is the idiomatic verb for decorating a surface with patterns; 'geverf' can suggest simply painting the car a colour.
